SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NVL(TS.PROC_DT, TS.REQUEST_DT) DESC, TS.SERVICE_ID DESC) AS SEQ, TS.WORK_CD, TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.LINK_ID, NVL(TS.CAR_NO, TN.CAR_NO) AS CAR_NO, TS.PROC_ST, CASE WHEN NVL(TN.DIRECT_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'DIRCT' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('C_REQ', 'REQ') THEN 'REQ' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('INPUT', 'SAV') THEN 'SAV' WHEN TS.PROC_ST = 'W_REQ' THEN 'W_REQ' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('B_REQ', 'P_REQ') THEN 'P_REQ' WHEN TS.PROC_ST = 'PREND' THEN 'PREND' WHEN TS.PROC_ST = 'PBEND' THEN 'PBEND' WHEN TS.PROC_ST = 'P_END' THEN 'P_END' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('S_REQ', 'S_END', 'J_REQ', 'J_ING', 'D_MAN', 'D_PAM', 'D_DAC') THEN 'S_REQ' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('J_END', 'J_WTX', 'D_REQ', 'D_ING', 'D_END', 'D_CON', 'D_DLY', 'D_PAY', 'END') THEN 'S_END' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('RET', 'REJECT') THEN 'RET' ELSE TS.PROC_ST END AS NPROC_ST, NVL(TN.DIRECT_YN, 'N') AS DIRECT_YN, TN.PAY_ST, NVL(TN.BPAY_YN, 'N') AS BPAY_YN, CASE WHEN NVL(TN.PAY_ST, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(TN.BPAY_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '납부' WHEN NVL(TN.PAY_ST, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(TN.BPAY_YN, 'N') = 'N' THEN '등록비용 납부' WHEN NVL(TN.PAY_ST, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(TN.BPAY_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '차량대금 납부' ELSE '미납' END AS PAY_STATUS_NM, TN.PAY_ME, TO_CHAR(TS.REQUEST_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REQUEST_DT, NVL(TS.PROC_DT, TS.REQUEST_DT) AS SORT_DT, TO_CHAR(TS.JUDGE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS JUDGE_DT, TO_CHAR(TN.PAY_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PAY_DT, TO_CHAR(TN.BPAY_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS BPAY_DT, TO_CHAR(TN.REGIST_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REGIST_DT, TN.VBANK_NO, TN.TOTAL_AMT, NVL(TMD.MEMBER_NM, '다코스대행') AS MEMBER_NM, TB.BRANCH_NM, TS.MEMBER_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, TN.OWNER_NM AS REQUEST_NM, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'FEE') AS FEE_AMT, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'STAMP') AS STAMP_AMT, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'UREG') AS REGIS_AMT, (SELECT VBANK_NO FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'ACQ') AS EPAY_NO, (SELECT VBANK_NO FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'UREG') AS UREG_EPAY_NO, (SELECT PRE_PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'ACQ') AS PRE_ACQ_AMT, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'ACQ') AS ACQ_AMT, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'INJI') AS INJI_AMT, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'BOND') AS BOND_AMT, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'BFEE') AS BFEE_AMT, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'TMAN') AS TMAN_AMT, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'TPROX') AS TPROX_AMT, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'TNUM') AS NUMP_AMT, (SELECT PAY_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD = 'UNUM') AS NUMP_PROXY_AMT, (SELECT CONFIRM_NO FROM TR_DSIGN WHERE SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND DSIGN_SEQ = 1) AS CONFIRM_NO, '' AS DSIGN_GB, TS.GOVT_ID, TN.BOND_DC AS PAY_TP, TN.CARID_NO, TN.INJI_NO, TN.OWNER_NM AS CU_NAME, DECODE(TN.REG_GB, 'R', '1', 'F', '1', '2') AS REG_GB, DECODE(TN.REG_GB, 'R', SUBSTR(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.REG_NO), 1, 6), 'F', SUBSTR(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.REG_NO), 1, 6), PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.REG_NO)) AS REG_NO, TN.CAR_NM, TN.GOVT_TX, 0 AS MORT_COUNT, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.BASE_ADDRESS) AS BASE_ADDRESS, (SELECT SUM(PAY_AMT) FROM TR_PAYMENT TP WHERE TP.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND PAY_KD IN ('FEE', 'BOND', 'BFEE', 'TNUM', 'UNUM')) AS ORIX_NEWCAR_AMT, TN.TASK_CD, TN.PROC_CD, TN.REG_GB AS RAW_REG_GB FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TM_MEMBER_DT TMD ON TS.ASSOCIATION_ID = TMD.ASSOCIATION_ID AND TS.COMPANY_ID = TMD.COMPANY_ID AND TS.MEMBER_ID = TMD.MEMBER_ID JOIN TM_COMPANY TC ON TS.ASSOCIATION_ID = TC.ASSOCIATION_ID AND TS.COMPANY_ID = TC.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN TM_BRANCH TB ON TS.COMPANY_ID = TB.COMPANY_ID AND TS.BRANCH_ID = TB.BRANCH_ID WHERE TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND TS.PROC_ST <> 'DEL'
AND TS.COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID}
AND TS.BRANCH_ID = #{BRANCH_ID}
AND TS.BRANCH_ID = #{BRANCH_ID}
AND (TS.MEMBER_ID = #{MEMBER_ID} OR TMD.LOGIN_ID = #{MEMBER_ID})
AND ( TN.CARID_NO LIKE '%' || #{CAR_NO} || '%' OR TN.CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CAR_NO} || '%' OR TS.CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CAR_NO} || '%' )
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('C_REQ', 'REQ')
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('INPUT', 'SAV') AND NVL(TN.DIRECT_YN, 'N') <> 'Y'
AND TS.PROC_ST = 'W_REQ'
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('B_REQ', 'P_REQ')
AND TS.PROC_ST = 'PREND'
AND TS.PROC_ST = 'PBEND'
AND TS.PROC_ST = 'P_END'
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('S_REQ', 'S_END', 'J_REQ', 'J_ING', 'D_MAN', 'D_PAM', 'D_DAC')
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('J_END', 'J_WTX', 'D_REQ', 'D_ING', 'D_END', 'D_CON', 'D_DLY', 'D_PAY', 'END')
AND NVL(TN.DIRECT_YN, 'N') = 'Y'
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('RET', 'REJECT')
AND TS.PROC_ST = #{PROC_ST}
AND NVL(TN.PAY_ST, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(TN.BPAY_YN, 'N') = 'Y'
AND NVL(TN.PAY_ST, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(TN.BPAY_YN, 'N') = 'N'
AND NVL(TN.PAY_ST, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(TN.BPAY_YN, 'N') = 'Y'
AND NVL(TN.PAY_ST, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(TN.BPAY_YN, 'N') = 'N'
AND TS.PROC_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS')
AND TS.REQUEST_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY SORT_DT DESC, TS.SERVICE_ID DESC

SELECT TS.COMPANY_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, TS.WORK_CD, COUNT(1) AS TOT_CNT, SUM(PM.PAY_AMT) AS TOT_AMT FROM TR_PAYMENT PM, TR_SERVICE TS, TM_COMPANY TC WHERE PM.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND TS.COMPANY_ID = TC.COMPANY_ID AND PM.PAY_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY TS.COMPANY_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, TS.WORK_CD ORDER BY TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.WORK_CD

SELECT PM.SERVICE_ID, TS.COMPANY_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, TS.CAR_NO, PM.TOTAL_AMT, PM.PAY_ST, TO_CHAR(TS.REQUEST_DT, 'MM.DD HH24:MI') AS REQUEST_DT FROM TR_PAYMENT PM, TR_SERVICE TS, TM_COMPANY TC WHERE PM.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND TS.COMPANY_ID = TC.COMPANY_ID AND PM.PAY_ST = 'NOTPAY' AND TS.REQUEST_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY TS.REQUEST_DT DESC

SELECT PR.RETURN_ID, PR.SERVICE_ID, PR.COMPANY_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, PR.RETURN_AMT, PR.RETURN_ST, TO_CHAR(PR.REQ_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REQ_DT FROM TR_PAY_RETURN PR, TM_COMPANY TC WHERE PR.COMPANY_ID = TC.COMPANY_ID(+) AND PR.REQ_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY PR.REQ_DT DESC

SELECT IJ.INJI_ID, IJ.SERVICE_ID, IJ.COMPANY_ID, TC.COMPANY_NM, IJ.INJI_AMT, IJ.INJI_ST, TO_CHAR(IJ.REQ_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REQ_DT FROM TR_INJISE_MANAGE IJ, TM_COMPANY TC WHERE IJ.COMPANY_ID = TC.COMPANY_ID(+) AND IJ.REQ_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY IJ.REQ_DT DESC

SELECT SERVICE_ID, PAY_KD, PAY_AMT, PAY_OP, PAY_ST, PRE_PAY_AMT, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, TO_CHAR (PAY_DT, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PAY_DT, T_VBANK_GB, T_VBANK_ID, REAL_ALOAN FROM TR_PAYMENT WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{serviceId} ORDER BY PAY_KD

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT WORK_CD, STAMP_PER, STAMP_AMT, REGIST_PER, REGIST_AMT, STAMP_BASE, REGIST_BASE, ACQ1_PER, ACQ2_PER, ACQ3_PER, ACQ210_PER, ACQ211_PER, ACQ0_PER FROM TM_TAX WHERE WORK_CD = #{WORK_CD} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN START_DT AND END_DT AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY START_DT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT DT.BANK_CODE AS BANK_CODE ,FIELD2 ,FIELD16 ,FIELD18 ,FIELD23 ,FIELD24 ,FIELD25 ,FIELD26 ,FIELD27 ,FIELD28 ,FIELD29 ,FIELD30 ,FIELD50 ,''as BND_MNG_NO, '' as RPS_APP_NO,'' as BND_ISU_NO ,'즉시 매도 내역' AS BK_NM ,'' ASCOL_IST_NM ,'' AS NAPBU_DT ,TO_CHAR(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS NAPBU_DT2 FROM WCMS_GW_TR_DT DT WHERE FIELD50 = #SERVICE_ID# AND TR_CODE IN ( 'WRT18', 'VRT18') AND DT.STATUS = '31' ORDER BY TR_END_TIME DESC

SELECT DT.BANK_CODE AS BANK_CODE ,FIELD2 ,FIELD16 ,FIELD18 ,FIELD23 ,FIELD24 ,FIELD25 ,FIELD26 ,FIELD27 ,FIELD28 ,FIELD29 ,FIELD30 ,FIELD50 ,BND_MNG_NO ,RPS_APP_NO ,BND_ISU_NO ,'즉시 매도 내역(' || BK_NM || ')' AS BK_NM ,COL_IST_NM ,TO_CHAR( TO_DATE(SAL_DY, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS NAPBU_DT FROM WCMS_GW_TR_DT DT ,WCMS_GW_PUBLIC_BOND_LOG LOG WHERE DT.REQUEST_DATE = LOG.TRCOM_SEND_DATE AND DT.FIELD3 = LOG.RPS_APP_NO AND FIELD50 = #{SERVICE_ID} AND TR_CODE IN ('WRT18', 'VRT18') AND DT.STATUS = '31'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_PAYMENT ( SERVICE_ID, PAY_KD, PAY_AMT, PAY_OP, PAY_ST, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, PAY_DT, T_VBANK_GB, T_VBANK_ID, INS_USER, PRE_PAY_AMT, REAL_ALOAN ) VALUES ( #{SERVICE_ID}, #{PAY_KD}, NVL(#{PAY_AMT}, 0), #{PAY_OP}, #{PAY_ST}, #{VBANK_CD}, #{VBANK_NO}, TO_DATE(TRIM(#{PAY_DT}), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS'), #{T_VBANK_GB}, #{T_VBANK_ID}, #{MEMBER_ID}, NVL(#{PRE_PAY_AMT}, 0), NVL(#{REAL_ALOAN}, 0) )
